path.description: The path to the project WPROJ file. For using WAAPI on Mac, please refer to \ref waapi_path_on_mac .

onUpgrade.description: (DEPRECATED) The action to be executed when opening a project that needs to be upgraded. Note, this is deprecated. Please use onMigrationRequired instead.

onMigrationRequired.description: The action to be executed when opening a project that needs to be migrated.

bypassSave.description: Indicates if the user should not be prompted to save the current project. Defaults to true.

autoCheckOutToSourceControl.description: Determines if Wwise automatically performs a Checkout source control operation for affected work units and for the project. Defaults to true.

examples.description: Opens the .wproj project specified by path.
examples.title: Opening a project
